feature_intro.title: An AI humanizer that fixes tone, not meaning
feature_intro.description: An AI humanizer that works on the passage you paste — it fixes concrete AI-writing patterns, shows you which ones it fixed, and never adds a fact you didn't write.

items.title: Two options to compare
items.description: Every run produces two rewrite options side by side, so you can keep the wording you prefer instead of accepting a single take.

items.title: Issues shown, not hidden
items.description: Each option lists the specific patterns it fixed — like hollow transitions or stacked qualifiers — instead of a black-box 'made it more natural'.

items.title: Changes you can see
items.description: Wording that changed is highlighted in the selected rewrite, and your original text stays on screen for a line-by-line check.

how_to_use.title: How to use the AI Humanizer
how_to_use.description: From a pasted passage to a reviewed, natural-sounding rewrite in four steps.

items.title: Paste your text
items.description: Paste a paragraph or short passage into the AI humanizer. Your text stays in the form and is never saved.

items.title: Set output language and requirements
items.description: Follow the input language or pick another, and add optional requirements about tone or wording to preserve.

items.title: Compare two rewrite options
items.description: Read Option A and Option B side by side, along with the specific issues each one fixed.

items.title: Review changes and copy
items.description: Check the highlighted wording against the original, verify facts and citations, then copy the selected rewrite.

feature_benefits.title: Why writers use this AI Humanizer
feature_benefits.description: A focused AI humanizer — two candidates, every fixed issue labeled, and every change visible.

items.title: Structural fixes, not word-swapping
items.description: The rewriter targets structural AI-writing patterns — hollow openers, forced triads, stacked qualifiers — rather than just swapping a few buzzwords.

items.title: Transparent about what changed
items.description: The detected-issues list turns editorial judgment into something you can see and check, instead of a black box.

items.title: Reminders to protect your facts
items.description: Changed wording is highlighted and you are reminded to review facts, quotations, and citations before using the result.

feature_section.title: What the AI Humanizer can rewrite
feature_section.description: Any single paragraph or short passage you can paste — the AI humanizer works with the text you give it.

items.title: AI-drafted blog posts
items.description: Smooth out hollow transitions and buzzword inflation from a first AI draft — then verify every claim before publishing.

items.title: Marketing and product copy
items.description: Cut promotional puffery and forced triads while keeping the features and specs you actually listed.

items.title: Academic and report drafts
items.description: Reduce mechanical transition stacking and vague attribution — then reread citations and figures before submitting.

items.title: Emails and messages
items.description: Remove customer-service filler tone from an AI-assisted reply while keeping the actual information.

faq_section.title: AI Humanizer FAQ
faq_section.description: How the tool works, what it does with your text, and what to expect from the results.

items.title: Does this help my text pass an AI detector?
items.description: The AI Humanizer is built to make text read more naturally and less mechanically — it is not designed or tested to defeat any specific AI-detection tool, and we don't make claims about detector scores or pass rates.

items.title: Why do I get two rewrite options?
items.description: Each run produces Option A and Option B — two different natural-sounding takes on the same passage. Reading them side by side makes it easy to choose the wording that fits your context.

items.title: What are the 'issues fixed' tags?
items.description: Each option lists the specific AI-writing patterns it corrected, such as hollow transitions, forced three-item lists, or stacked qualifiers. This shows you the reasoning behind the rewrite instead of a single vague result.

items.title: Which language is the rewrite in?
items.description: By default the rewrite follows the language of your pasted text: an English passage stays English, a Chinese passage stays Chinese. You can also pick a fixed output language from the dropdown.

items.title: Is my text private?
items.description: Yes. The AI Humanizer sends your pasted text to generate the rewrites and does not save it to your account or our database. Only anonymous usage counts are recorded — never your text or the generated result.

items.title: Will it keep facts, quotations, and citations intact?
items.description: The rewriter is instructed to preserve factual content, quotations, and citations while rewording, but rephrasing can still introduce errors. Highlighted changes mark where wording moved — always review them against your original before using the result.

items.title: How is this different from Paragraph Rewriter?
items.description: Paragraph Rewriter targets a general goal you pick, like clearer or more formal. AI Humanizer specifically targets AI-sounding patterns and shows you which ones it found and fixed.

cta_section.title: Humanize the passage, then keep writing
cta_section.description: Once your text reads the way you want, open AI Write to draft the sections around it — with Story Bible and Consistency Check available inside the editor.
